entities.summary: Ángel Salas Larrazábal was a Spanish military officer, military attaché, and flying ace. He fought for the Nationalist faction during the Spanish Civil War and was the first commander of the Blue Squadron of World War II during Operation Barbarossa.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ángel Salas Larrazábal was a Spanish military officer, military attaché, and flying ace. He fought for the Nationalist faction during the Spanish Civil War and was the first commander of the Blue Squadron of World War II during Operation Barbarossa.
